name: crypto-market-pulse
description: One-command market pulse for any listed crypto token — Otto AI token-details (price/mcap/volume), token-alpha (derivatives OI, funding, order flow, positioning, technicals), crypto-news (sentiment-ranked headlines), and news-recaps (hourly market recap) — fused into a compact non-advisory directional brief. Paid per call via selat-pay (x402 on Base/Polygon) through the SELAT Router.

symbol.description: Token symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE). Used as ${symbol} in each step URL. Always pass the user's symbol explicitly; never let the default silently research another token.

steps.label: token details — Otto token-details (x402 on Base)
market recap — Otto news-recaps (x402 on Base)
news sentiment — Otto crypto-news (x402 on Base)
alpha intelligence — Otto token-alpha (x402 on Base)
